title: Allow null results in task schemas
objective: Update the ten task-specific payload schemas so task.result accepts either null or the existing task-specific result object, preserving the existing non-null result contract and changing no unrelated schema or runtime behavior.

branch.name: WI-0039-null-task-results
branch.rationale: The work item changes the result property contract in the ten task-specific schemas and must be reviewed as a bounded schema-only change.

request.text:
Prepare a new .docs/work-items/WI-0039/* (work-item.json and implementation task file) in order to update our schemas to allow a null result.

Review the generated work-item.json and then generated implementation task file to ensure they're scope bound to only update the task schemas to allow a null result.

Commit the new work item.

scope.name: nullable-task-results
scope.description: Change the result property in each of the ten task-specific payload schemas to accept null in addition to its existing task-specific result object schema.
scope.reason: Planned and transitional task envelopes need to represent an absent result as null while retaining the existing result contract for populated task results.

nonGoals.name: envelope-schema-change
nonGoals.description: Do not modify sdlc-task-envelope/v1 or its task wrapper result property.
nonGoals.reason: The envelope already accepts an object or null; this change belongs only in task-specific payload schemas.

nonGoals.name: runtime-validation-change
nonGoals.description: Do not modify CLI commands, runtime validators, lifecycle policy code, or result-field interpretation.
nonGoals.reason: The requested change is limited to schema contracts; existing host validation should consume the updated contracts without behavioral changes.

nonGoals.name: unrelated-schema-change
nonGoals.description: Do not modify CLI response schemas, design-validation reports, task-next responses, common reference schemas, or any schema outside the ten task-specific payload schemas.
nonGoals.reason: The result nullability contract must remain narrowly scoped to schemas selected by taskType.

nonGoals.name: task-record-migration
nonGoals.description: Do not rewrite existing task records, add result fields, or change lifecycle statuses merely because null becomes schema-valid.
nonGoals.reason: The work item changes the reusable schema contract and does not migrate persisted task data.

items.name: nullable-task-result-contract
items.description: Each supported task-specific payload schema must define its result property as oneOf null and the existing task-specific result object schema.
items.reason: The host validator must be able to validate a planned or transitional task payload whose result is explicitly null without weakening the populated result contract.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The result property in task-decomposition, task-research, task-decision, task-design, task-implementation, task-test-strategy, task-validation, task-review, task-rework, and task-delivery is a oneOf containing type null and the existing result object schema.
The existing non-null result object schema remains the unchanged object alternative, including its required fields, properties, lifecycle metadata, and result-specific validation rules.

items.name: schema-only-boundary
items.description: The implementation must modify only the ten task-specific payload schema files and must not change envelope, runtime, response, common-reference, design-validation, task-next, or persisted task artifacts.
items.reason: The requested repair addresses task-specific result validation only and must not expand into runtime or data migration work.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The implementation task owned paths contain exactly the ten task-specific schema families and no source, test, CLI response, envelope, common-schema, or work-item artifact paths.
Schema validation confirms representative null-result and existing object-result instances against the updated task-specific contracts without requiring runtime code changes.

versionSuggestion.rationale: Adds an accepted null alternative to existing task-specific result contracts without changing the populated result object shapes.
versionSuggestion.disclaimer: This is an inferred recommendation; increase the impact if final changes are larger or more breaking than expected.
